'''''James''''' was a [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The corvette was in reserve should the other modified corvette ''[[Burke]]'' was destroyed during an operation to capture one of two [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|Escort Carriers]] [[Prowler (escort carriers)|''Prowler'']].
